Search from a large index of web pages with optional local and rich data enrichments, with results intended for human consumption.

Part of [`seek web brave`](seek-web-brave.md).

## Usage

```text
seek web brave search [options] <query...>
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query...` | Yes, one or more | Search query |  |

## Options

| Option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-n, --num <number>` | Number of results | `10` |
| `--fresh <window>` | Freshness window: pd (past day), pw (week), pm (month), py (year) |  |
| `--country <cc>` | Two-letter country code (e.g. US, GB) |  |
| `--json` | Emit raw JSON response |  |
| `-h, --help` | display help for command |  |

## Exit statuses

`seek web brave search` exits with one of the [exit statuses of `seek`](seek.md#exit-statuses).

## Help
